notes: Single-clock check on i_clk_slv. The check is gated by PARA_APBCDC_APB5==1 and by i_rst_n_mst being high, as the spec says both resets are high. The slv reset is handled by disable iff. i_rst_n_mst is only used as a level qualifier, not bridged across domains. I did not compile this in Verilator.
